hypotheses.justification: This is used only to apply the locally-constant-rank lemma in the given proof. For any prime p, the same localization-rank argument used at ⊥ works directly: since S is a domain, p.asIdeal.primeCompl consists of nonzero elements and is contained in nonZeroDivisors S. Apply IsLocalization.rank_eq and IsLocalizedModule.rank_eq to get rank of the localized module equal to hrank, then Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq gives the stated equality. The latter lemma requires only the rank equality, not finite presentation.

Flatness is used only for the locally-constant-rank step in the given proof. As above, for each p the localization-rank equalities directly identify the stalk's rank with Module.rank S M; this proof works without flatness, including at every prime of the domain.
